evidence.title: REQPY: Spectral Matching & Signal Processing Library

name: REQPY
summary: Python module for matching earthquake records to target response spectra (PSA, RotDnn) with FAS and PSD compliance.
description: A Python library for spectral matching of earthquake ground motions using continuous wavelet transforms. It matches a single component or a pair of horizontal components to target response spectra (PSA and RotDnn/RotD100), optionally while satisfying minimum Fourier amplitude spectrum (FAS) and power spectral density (PSD) targets, and computes FAS, PSD, RotDnn, EAS and EPSD with smoothing options including Konno-Ohmachi. Eight documented example scripts run from simple matching to three-stage PSA→FAS→PSD generation, and baseline correction methods are selectable.
contains: single-component and RotDnn (RotD100) response spectrum matching
PSA + minimum FAS + minimum PSD compliant generation
computes FAS, PSD, RotDnn, EAS and EPSD with Konno-Ohmachi smoothing
baseline corrections: sixth-order, piecewise, classic or none
8 documented example scripts in the repo
dependencies: NumPy, SciPy (>= 1.6), Matplotlib, Numba; optional pykooh
MIT licensed; author Luis A. Montejo (UPR)
